description: Defines an abstract base class 'EntityBase' implementing 'EntityInterface' for Drupal entities, including methods for URL generation, cache management, entity lifecycle, and dependency handling.

classes.name: EntityBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing core entity functionalities such as URL handling, cache invalidation, lifecycle hooks, and dependency management for Drupal entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the entity with provided values and entity type.

methods.name: entityTypeManager
methods.description: Retrieves the entity type manager service.

methods.name: entityTypeBundleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the entity type bundle info service.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if the entity is new.

methods.name: enforceIsNew
methods.description: Sets whether the entity should be enforced as new.

methods.name: bundle
methods.description: Returns the bundle name, same as entity type ID.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the entity.

methods.name: toUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for the entity based on link templates and callbacks.

methods.name: hasLinkTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a link template exists for a given relation.

methods.name: linkTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves link templates for the entity type.

methods.name: toLink
methods.description: Creates a Link object for the entity.

methods.name: urlRouteParameters
methods.description: Generates route parameters for URL generation.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for an operation.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Returns the language object for the entity.

methods.name: createDuplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the entity with a new ID and UUID.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Hook before saving; checks bundle ID length.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Hook after saving; invalidates cache tags.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Hook after deletion; invalidates cache tags.

methods.name: getListCacheTagsToInvalidate
methods.description: Returns cache tags for list invalidation.

methods.name: getCacheTagsToInvalidate
methods.description: Returns cache tags for this entity.

methods.name: getTypedDataClass
methods.description: Determines the typed data class for the entity.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares object for serialization, resets typedData.
